01 / The real work

The hard part is not calling an LLM.

Your applications, APIs, data, identities, approvals and operating procedures already exist. The engineering work is connecting them safely and usefully. We take on that integration burden, working with the environment you trust.

02 / Working principles

Fit the business. Make authority explicit.

Governed AI that works with your business, not around it.

  • 01

    Use your existing systems

    No re-engineering around us. Integrate with the systems, data, identities and workflows your organization already uses.

  • 02

    No implicit authority

    Each agent has explicit identity, permissions, scope and approval. Claiming authority in a prompt cannot create it.

  • 03

    Humans stay in control

    Automate authorized routine work. Escalate risk, uncertainty and exceptional conditions to the people responsible.

03 / What we help you deliver

From infrastructure decisions to working systems.

Architecture guidance, hands-on engineering and technical enablement for enterprise teams and SI partners.

  1. 01

    Platform architecture, dependency discovery, container and virtualization choices, staged migration plans and operational handover.

  2. 02

  3. 03

04 / Human attention is valuable

AI handles volume. Humans handle judgment.

Do not make people rubber-stamp every routine result. Route the right cases to review, using explicit rules and evidence.

  • 01

    Normal result

    Continue within the approved workflow.

  • 02

    High value, missing evidence or conflicting data

    Pause for human review.

  • 03

    Low confidence

    Escalate uncertainty; do not invent certainty.

  • 04

    Policy violation

    Block the action and request human review.

  • 05

    Large blast radius

    Require explicit approval before execution.
